title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): multichannel customer outreach across web chat, voice, SMS and email
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned channels, development status and past target dates. Microsoft documents the product licence, but the searches found no documentation identifying this particular agent or establishing its default, feature-specific charges or outreach controls.
